reannounce.title: Reannounce
reannounce.noInstances: No instances configured. Add one in Settings to use this service.
reannounce.tooltip: qBittorrent doesn't retry failed announces quickly. When a tracker is slow to register a new upload or returns an error, you may be stuck waiting. qui handles this automatically while never spamming trackers.
reannounce.description: Monitors stalled torrents and reannounces them when no tracker is healthy.
reannounce.tryDifferentSearch: Try a different search term or clear the filter.
reannounce.eventsAppearHere: Events will appear here when stalled torrents are detected.
reannounce.enableMonitoring: Enable monitoring to start tracking stalled torrents.

orphanScan.title: Orphan Scan
orphanScan.noInstances: No instances configured. Add one in Settings to use this service.
orphanScan.tooltip: Finds files on disk that are not associated with any torrent in qBittorrent. Requires local filesystem access to be enabled for each instance.
orphanScan.description: Scans download directories and identifies orphan files for cleanup.
orphanScan.localAccessTooltip: qui and qBittorrent must run on the same machine. Enable "Local Filesystem Access" in instance settings to use orphan scanning.
orphanScan.scanTruncated: (scan was truncated, more files may exist)
orphanScan.noScansYet: No scans run yet. Click "Scan Now" to find orphan files.
